title: [C20T3] - A public library in Little Chalfont
prompt: The charts below give information about a public library in a town called Little Chalfont. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The charts provide information about Little Chalfont Library, illustrating the age demographics of library members, the distribution of loans across different categories in 2016, and the total number of loans from 2007 to 2016.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, adults aged 18-64 formed the majority of members, while fiction books dominated borrowing for both children and adults. In addition, the total number of loans increased significantly over the decade.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Regarding membership age distribution in 2016, adults between 18 and 64 represented just over half at 51%. Children accounted for 22%, while young adults aged 13-17 comprised 15%. Seniors aged 65 and over made up the smallest group at 12%.

frame.name: Body 2 + Body 3
paragraphs: In terms of borrowing patterns, children's fiction and adult fiction each dominated with 38% of total loans. Adult non-fiction followed at 13%, while children's non-fiction accounted for 6%. The remaining categories were minimal, with young adults representing 2%, adult audio books 2%, and children's DVDs just 1%.

The total number of loans demonstrated steady growth from approximately 15,500 in 2007 to 23,000 in 2016. The most significant increase occurred between 2007 and 2011, rising to around 21,000 loans. From 2012 onwards, loan numbers remained relatively stable with minor fluctuations before reaching their peak in the final year.
